title: Focus Board primary interface
objective: Build the accessible add-and-toggle interface on the exact applied domain foundation.
requirements: TaskComposer renders a semantic form with visible Task and Group labels, Work and Personal options, and an Add task submit button; valid submission delegates to onAdd and clears only the title input, while blank submission does nothing.
TaskItem renders one native checkbox associated with the task title and a visible Work or Personal group label.
TaskList always renders a semantic unordered list in creation order and shows No tasks yet beside the empty list when no tasks exist.

App preserves the accepted Focus Board header, keeps task state in React memory, delegates creation and toggle transitions to the applied domain functions, and composes TaskComposer with TaskList using the frozen stylesheet.

skills.name: Accessible controlled form
skills.content: Import type { JSX } from react and use React in-memory controlled state for title and group. Export exactly TaskComposerProps and TaskComposer with the planned signatures, using the identifier `props`. Render a native form.task-form. Render visible label.field elements around the Task input and Group select. Use work and personal option values with Work and Personal copy. On submit, trim only to decide whether the value is valid; call props.onAdd with the current title and group so the domain remains authoritative for normalization. Clear the title only after a valid submission. Put the submit button in .form-actions.

constraints: Do not add inline styles or edit CSS.
